title: chamaesyce hirta subsp. procumbens
intro: Chamaesyce hirta subsp. procumbens, commonly known as Coast Spurge, is a plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a succulent perennial that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Coast Spurge include its ability to treat skin conditions such as eczema and acne, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
